details: The bold white caps hit you before you even mean to read it.

Crisp white print on soft black cotton, it really pops.
It's super soft and the fit is relaxed without being baggy.
The condensed lettering stacks so cleanly, it reads like a sign.
Honestly the best gag gift for the coworker who annoys everyone.
The print stays sharp, even after a bunch of washes.
The contrast is so clean people can read it across the room.
It's comfy enough to wear all day, and funny enough to get noticed.
Perfect gift for the friend who loves getting under people's skin.
The layout builds up to the joke one line at a time.
followups: Then they smooth the shirt flat with both hands so the full print shows.
